prompt.adult: According to Isaiah 11:5, after “Righteousness shall be,” what is named first?
prompt.child: Isaiah describes the coming ruler’s dress. After “Righteousness shall be,” what does 11:5 name first?
prompt.older: According to Isaiah 11:5, what follows “Righteousness shall be”?

choices.text: the belt of His loins
the crown of His head
the robe of His back
the staff of His hand

verses.text: Righteousness shall be the belt of His loins, And faithfulness the belt of His waist.

explanation.child: Look right after “Righteousness shall be” in verse 5.
explanation.teen: 11:5 opens with this phrase. Read that phrase.

teaching.extended_explanation: 11:5 also says, “And faithfulness” is about His waist.
teaching.takeaway: Righteousness shall be the belt of His loins.

prompt.adult: Isaiah 10:21 says, “The remnant will return, the remnant of Jacob.” In 10:20, after “Will never again depend on him,” what does the verse say they will never do?
prompt.child: Isaiah describes those who have escaped of the house of Jacob. After “Will never again depend on him,” what does 10:20 say?
prompt.teen: Isaiah 10:20: “Will never again depend on him” what?

choices.text: Will never again depend on him who gathered them
Will never again depend on him who defeated them
Will never again depend on him who rescued them
Will never again depend on him who settled them

verses.text: And it shall come to pass in that day That the remnant of Israel, And such as have escaped of the house of Jacob, Will never again depend on him who defeated them, But will depend on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
The remnant will return, the remnant of Jacob, To the Mighty God.

explanation.child: Look right after “Will never again depend on him” in verse 20.
explanation.teen: 10:21 names the remnant of Jacob; 10:20 names this dependence they will leave. Read that sentence.
explanation.older: It follows “Will never again depend on him” in 10:20.

teaching.extended_explanation: 10:20 also says they “Will depend on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.” 10:21 also says, “To the Mighty God.”
teaching.takeaway: Will never again depend on him who defeated them.
